A Japan–India venture preparing to approach financiers

A promising project needs a case that financiers can assess.

The situation

A Japanese equipment company and an Indian partner are planning a production facility in India. They have a technical concept and interested customers, but have not yet worked out how much funding each stage needs, how costs and risks could be shared, or how to present the opportunity to financiers.

How SetuHashi could help

Assess funding needs and what each stage must demonstrate, explore risk-sharing options, prepare the commercial investment case and coordinate introductions to financing partners through authorized specialists.

What the assignment could produce

A staged funding plan, risk-sharing options for discussion, a documented investment case and supported introductions. Regulated financial and investment advice is provided by qualified specialists.

The intended value

Financing discussions that start from a clear, staged case. Funding decisions remain with the financiers.
